# Overview

::: {.callout-note .callout-download collapse="true"}
# Code for dataset loading, plotting defaults

## Dataset loading
We load the gesture dataframe.
```{r} 
library(cowplot)
library(ggplot2)
# Use this conditional approach:
if (rstudioapi::isAvailable()) {
  # Running in RStudio
  current_dir <- dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)
} else {
  # Running outside RStudio (like command line quarto)
  current_dir <- here::here()
}

# load full data
fulldat <- read.csv(paste0(current_dir, "/Data_Output/gestures_long.csv"))
fulldat$gesture_id <- as.factor(fulldat$gesture_id)
fulldat$corpus <- as.factor(fulldat$corpus)
fulldat$speaker <- as.factor(fulldat$speaker)
fulldat$subtype <- as.factor(fulldat$subtype)
fulldat$condition <- as.factor(fulldat$condition)

# gesture category only
gesdat <- subset(fulldat, condition == "gesture")
gesdat$corpus <- droplevels(gesdat$corpus)
gesdat$speaker <- droplevels(gesdat$speaker)
gesdat$gesture_id <- droplevels(gesdat$gesture_id)

# objman category only
objman_dat <- subset(fulldat, condition == "objman")
objman_dat$corpus <- droplevels(objman_dat$corpus)
objman_dat$speaker <- droplevels(objman_dat$speaker)
objman_dat$gesture_id <- droplevels(objman_dat$gesture_id)
```

# Set some plotting defaults

# Enhanced plotting theme

# colors - more contrastive
corpus_colors <- c(
  "ECOLANG" = "#E41A1C",
  "GESres" = "#377EB8",

)
```

#### Models
The models that we construct all share that they have as their response variable the log-transformed `subm_dur_ms` (submovement duration), and as a fixed effect predictor the log-transformed `n_submovements` (number of submovements). Since there are multiple observations of submovement durations per gesture, we include `gesture_id` as a random effect nested within `speaker` and `corpus` to account for this non-independence. We follow closely the modeling approach of [@wascherVocalEfficiencyCrows2025] as provided here [https://masonyoungblood.github.io/crow_efficiency/](https://masonyoungblood.github.io/crow_efficiency/).

Below the blocks allows for inspection of the mixed regression models, their equations, plotting code.

::: {.callout-note .callout-download collapse="true"}
# Key mixed regression models for assessing Menzerath-Altman law
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(dplyr)
library(equatiomatic)

# remove any rows with single submovement gestures
gesdat <- gesdat[gesdat$n_submovements > 1, ]

# Basic Menzerath model with corpus in random structure
gesture_menz_model <- lmer(scale(log(subm_dur_ms)) ~ scale(log(n_submovements)) + (1|corpus/speaker/gesture_id), data = gesdat)

# For LaTeX output
equationmenz <- extract_eq(gesture_menz_model, use_coefs = TRUE)
```
:::

# Plotting code for Menzerath's law models
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(lmerTest)
library(svglite)

# create plots folder
dir.create(paste0(current_dir, "/plots"), showWarnings = FALSE)

# Extract fixed effects coefficients
coef_menz <- fixef(gesture_menz_model)

# get median submovement duration per gesture
gesdat_summary <- gesdat %>%
  group_by(gesture_id, n_submovements, corpus) %>%
  summarise(subm_dur_median = median(subm_dur_ms), .groups = "drop")

# scale using the full dataset parameters (as.numeric to avoid matrix)
gesdat_summary$x_scaled <- as.numeric(scale(log(gesdat_summary$n_submovements)))
gesdat_summary$y_scaled <- as.numeric(scale(log(gesdat_summary$subm_dur_median)))

# Create prediction line using same scaling
pred_x <- seq(min(gesdat_summary$x_scaled), max(gesdat_summary$x_scaled), length.out = 100)
pred_y <- coef_menz[1] + coef_menz[2] * pred_x
pred_line <- data.frame(x = pred_x, y = pred_y)

# per-corpus regression lines
corpus_lines <- gesdat_summary %>%
  group_by(corpus) %>%
  summarise(
    intercept = coef(lm(y_scaled ~ x_scaled))[1],
    slope = coef(lm(y_scaled ~ x_scaled))[2],
    x_min = min(x_scaled),
    x_max = max(x_scaled),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do({
    x_seq <- seq(.$x_min, .$x_max, length.out = 50)
    data.frame(corpus = .$corpus, x = x_seq, y = .$intercept + .$slope * x_seq)
  })

# main plot with all data
p1 <- ggplot(gesdat_summary, aes(x = x_scaled, y = y_scaled, color = corpus)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  geom_line(data = corpus_lines, aes(x = x, y = y, color = corpus), linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 2) +
  geom_line(data = pred_line, aes(x = x, y = y), color = "black", linewidth = 1.2, inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, 
           label = sprintf("overall: y = %.3f + %.3fx", coef_menz[1], coef_menz[2]),
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 2.5) +
  labs(x = "Scaled log(Number of Submovements)", 
       y = "Scaled log(Submovement Duration)",
       title = "Menzerath's Law: All Corpora") +
  scale_color_manual(values = corpus_colors) +
  my_theme()

# faceted plot per corpus
p_facet <- ggplot(gesdat_summary, aes(x = x_scaled, y = y_scaled, color = corpus)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  geom_line(data = corpus_lines, aes(x = x, y = y, color = corpus), linewidth = 2) +
  geom_line(data = pred_line, aes(x = x, y = y), color = "black", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ corpus, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "Scaled log(Number of Submovements)", 
       y = "Scaled log(Submovement Duration)",
       title = "Menzerath's Law: Per Corpus") +
  scale_color_manual(values = corpus_colors, guide = "none") +
  my_theme() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

# combined plot
p_combined <- plot_grid(p1, p_facet, ncol = 1, rel_widths = c(1, 1.5), labels = c("A", "B"))

# save plots
ggsave(paste0(current_dir, "/plots/menzerath_all_corpora.svg"), p1, width = 8, height = 6)
ggsave(paste0(current_dir, "/plots/menzerath_per_corpus.svg"), p_facet, width = 12, height = 8)
ggsave(paste0(current_dir, "/plots/menzerath_combined.svg"), p_combined, width = 16, height = 6)
```
:::

# General pattern Menzerath's law in gestures
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(dplyr)

# Get coefficient summary from the basic model
sum_basic <- coef(summary(gesture_menz_model))

# Extract values for inline reporting
menz_slope <- sprintf("%.3f", sum_basic[2, "Estimate"])
menz_slope_se <- sprintf("%.3f", sum_basic[2, "Std. Error"])
menz_slope_t <- sprintf("%.2f", sum_basic[2, "t value"])
menz_slope_p <- ifelse(sum_basic[2, "Pr(>|t|)"] < 0.001, "< 0.001", 
                       sprintf("= %.3f", sum_basic[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]))

# Create basic Menzerath model coefficient table
menz_coef_table <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Intercept", "log(Number of Submovements)"),
  Estimate = c(sum_basic[1, "Estimate"], sum_basic[2, "Estimate"]),
  SE = c(sum_basic[1, "Std. Error"], sum_basic[2, "Std. Error"]),
  t_value = c(sum_basic[1, "t value"], sum_basic[2, "t value"]),
  p_value = c(sum_basic[1, "Pr(>|t|)"], sum_basic[2, "Pr(>|t|)"])
)

# Format p-values
menz_coef_table$p_formatted <- ifelse(menz_coef_table$p_value < 0.001, "< 0.001",
                                      sprintf("%.3f", menz_coef_table$p_value))
menz_coef_table$Estimate <- sprintf("%.3f", menz_coef_table$Estimate)
menz_coef_table$SE <- sprintf("%.3f", menz_coef_table$SE)
menz_coef_table$t_value <- sprintf("%.2f", menz_coef_table$t_value)
```

We assessed the overall relationship between number of submovements and submovement duration (beta = `r menz_slope`, SE = `r menz_slope_se`, p `r menz_slope_p`). 

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.height = 16, fig.width = 10, fig.cap="Figure. Scaling relationship according to the linear mixed regression model. (A) All corpora combined with overall regression line (black) and per-corpus lines. (B) Faceted view per corpus with overall line (dashed) for reference."}
p_combined
```


```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
menz_coef_table %>%
  select(Parameter, Estimate, SE, t_value, p_formatted) %>%
  kable(format = "html", 
        caption = "Table: Fixed Effects for Basic Menzerath Model",
        col.names = c("Parameter", "Estimate", "SE", "t-value", "p"),
        align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE)
```

# Per-corpus modeling and individual variability

::: {.callout-note .callout-download collapse="true"}
# Per-corpus model fitting
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(MuMIn)

# function to fit models and extract stats for a corpus
fit_corpus_model <- function(data, corpus_name) {
  corpus_data <- data[data$corpus == corpus_name, ]
  corpus_data$speaker <- droplevels(corpus_data$speaker)
  corpus_data$gesture_id <- droplevels(corpus_data$gesture_id)
  
  n_gestures <- length(unique(corpus_data$gesture_id))
  n_speakers <- length(unique(corpus_data$speaker))
  
  # log-log model
  mod_log <- lmer(scale(log(subm_dur_ms)) ~ scale(log(n_submovements)) + (1|speaker/gesture_id), 
                  data = corpus_data, REML = FALSE)
  
  # linear model
  mod_lin <- lmer(scale(subm_dur_ms) ~ scale(n_submovements) + (1|speaker/gesture_id), 
                  data = corpus_data, REML = FALSE)
  
  # extract stats
  sum_mod <- summary(mod_log)
  coefs <- coef(sum_mod)
  ci <- confint(mod_log, parm = "scale(log(n_submovements))", method = "Wald")
  
  # R2
  r2 <- r.squaredGLMM(mod_log)
  
  # speaker SD
  vc <- VarCorr(mod_log)
  speaker_sd <- attr(vc$speaker, "stddev")[1]
  
  # AIC comparison
  delta_aic <- AIC(mod_log) - AIC(mod_lin)
  
  data.frame(
    Corpus = corpus_name,
    N_gestures = n_gestures,
    N_speakers = n_speakers,
    beta = coefs[2, "Estimate"],
    SE = coefs[2, "Std. Error"],
    CI_low = ci[1, 1],
    CI_high = ci[1, 2],
    p = coefs[2, "Pr(>|t|)"],
    Speaker_SD = speaker_sd,
    R2_fixed = r2[1, "R2m"],
    R2_total = r2[1, "R2c"],
    delta_AIC = delta_aic
  )
}

# fit for gesture category - exclude ZHUBO (1 speaker)
corpora_gesture <- c("ECOLANG", "GESres", "MULTISIMO", "SAGA", "SAGAplus")
corpus_results_gesture <- do.call(rbind, lapply(corpora_gesture, function(c) fit_corpus_model(gesdat, c)))

# format table
corpus_table_gesture <- corpus_results_gesture
# remove row  names
row.names(corpus_table_gesture) <- NULL
corpus_table_gesture$beta_fmt <- sprintf("%.3f", corpus_table_gesture$beta)
corpus_table_gesture$SE_fmt <- sprintf("%.3f", corpus_table_gesture$SE)
corpus_table_gesture$CI_fmt <- sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", corpus_table_gesture$CI_low, corpus_table_gesture$CI_high)
corpus_table_gesture$p_fmt <- ifelse(corpus_table_gesture$p < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("%.3f", corpus_table_gesture$p))
corpus_table_gesture$Speaker_SD_fmt <- sprintf("%.3f", corpus_table_gesture$Speaker_SD)
corpus_table_gesture$R2_fixed_fmt <- sprintf("%.3f", corpus_table_gesture$R2_fixed)
corpus_table_gesture$R2_total_fmt <- sprintf("%.3f", corpus_table_gesture$R2_total)
corpus_table_gesture$delta_AIC_fmt <- sprintf("%.1f", corpus_table_gesture$delta_AIC)
```
:::

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
corpus_table_gesture %>%
  select(Corpus, N_gestures, N_speakers, beta_fmt, SE_fmt, CI_fmt, p_fmt, Speaker_SD_fmt, R2_fixed_fmt, R2_total_fmt, delta_AIC_fmt) %>%
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "Table: Per-corpus Menzerath effects for gesture category",
        col.names = c("Corpus", "N gestures", "N speakers", "beta", "SE", "95% CI", "p", "Speaker SD", "R2_fixed", "R2_total", "dAIC"),
        align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE) %>%
  footnote(general = "dAIC = AIC_loglog - AIC_linear; negative values indicate log-log model is better fit")
```

# Confound Analysis: Object Manipulation

To assess whether the Menzerath-Altman relationship is specific to communicative gestures, we repeat the analysis for object manipulation movements which were also annotated in the ECOLANG corpus. We should expect here that these movements follow communicative efficiency principles less (but they might be regulated by general efficiency principles).

::: {.callout-note .callout-download collapse="true"}
# Object manipulation analysis
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# filter for n_submovements > 1
objman_dat <- objman_dat[objman_dat$n_submovements > 1, ]

# model for objman - only ECOLANG has data, so no corpus random effect
objman_menz_model <- lmer(scale(log(subm_dur_ms)) ~ scale(log(n_submovements)) + (1|speaker/gesture_id), data = objman_dat)

# coefficients
coef_objman <- fixef(objman_menz_model)
sum_objman <- coef(summary(objman_menz_model))

# summary data
objman_summary <- objman_dat %>%
  group_by(gesture_id, n_submovements, corpus) %>%
  summarise(subm_dur_median = median(subm_dur_ms), .groups = "drop")

objman_summary$x_scaled <- as.numeric(scale(log(objman_summary$n_submovements)))
objman_summary$y_scaled <- as.numeric(scale(log(objman_summary$subm_dur_median)))

# prediction line
pred_x_obj <- seq(min(objman_summary$x_scaled), max(objman_summary$x_scaled), length.out = 100)
pred_y_obj <- coef_objman[1] + coef_objman[2] * pred_x_obj
pred_line_obj <- data.frame(x = pred_x_obj, y = pred_y_obj)

# per-corpus lines for objman (only ECOLANG)
corpus_lines_obj <- objman_summary %>%
  group_by(corpus) %>%
  summarise(
    intercept = coef(lm(y_scaled ~ x_scaled))[1],
    slope = coef(lm(y_scaled ~ x_scaled))[2],
    x_min = min(x_scaled),
    x_max = max(x_scaled),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do({
    x_seq <- seq(.$x_min, .$x_max, length.out = 50)
    data.frame(corpus = .$corpus, x = x_seq, y = .$intercept + .$slope * x_seq)
  })

# plot
p_objman <- ggplot(objman_summary, aes(x = x_scaled, y = y_scaled, color = corpus)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  geom_line(data = corpus_lines_obj, aes(x = x, y = y, color = corpus), linewidth = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = pred_line_obj, aes(x = x, y = y), color = "black", linewidth = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, 
           label = sprintf("overall: y = %.3f + %.3fx", coef_objman[1], coef_objman[2]),
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 2.5) +
  labs(x = "Scaled log(Number of Submovements)", 
       y = "Scaled log(Submovement Duration)",
       title = "Menzerath's Law: Object Manipulation") +
  scale_color_manual(values = corpus_colors) +
  my_theme()

# save
ggsave(paste0(current_dir, "/plots/menzerath_objman.svg"), p_objman, width = 8, height = 6)
```
:::

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# reporting values
objman_slope <- sprintf("%.3f", sum_objman[2, "Estimate"])
objman_slope_se <- sprintf("%.3f", sum_objman[2, "Std. Error"])
objman_slope_p <- ifelse(sum_objman[2, "Pr(>|t|)"] < 0.001, "< 0.001", 
                         sprintf("= %.3f", sum_objman[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]))

objman_coef_table <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Intercept", "log(Number of Submovements)"),
  Estimate = c(sum_objman[1, "Estimate"], sum_objman[2, "Estimate"]),
  SE = c(sum_objman[1, "Std. Error"], sum_objman[2, "Std. Error"]),
  t_value = c(sum_objman[1, "t value"], sum_objman[2, "t value"]),
  p_value = c(sum_objman[1, "Pr(>|t|)"], sum_objman[2, "Pr(>|t|)"])
)

objman_coef_table$p_formatted <- ifelse(objman_coef_table$p_value < 0.001, "< 0.001",
                                        sprintf("%.3f", objman_coef_table$p_value))
objman_coef_table$Estimate <- sprintf("%.3f", objman_coef_table$Estimate)
objman_coef_table$SE <- sprintf("%.3f", objman_coef_table$SE)
objman_coef_table$t_value <- sprintf("%.2f", objman_coef_table$t_value)
```

For object manipulation movements, we did not obtain reliable results (beta = `r objman_slope`, SE = `r objman_slope_se`, p `r objman_slope_p`), which is contrast to the previous analysis, also specifically in contrast to communicative gestures produced in the same ECOLANG corpus.

        align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r")) %>%
